snippets.name: Email signature
snippets.content: {{me.signature}}
snippets.description: Your signature from Settings → Profile.

snippets.name: Professional introduction
snippets.content:
Dear {{text: recipient; label=Recipient name; required}},

I hope this message finds you well. My name is {{me.name}}, {{me.title}} at {{me.company}}. I am reaching out regarding {{textarea: purpose; label=Purpose of the email; required}}.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss this further at your convenience.

Kind regards,
{{me.name}}
snippets.description: Introduce yourself to a new contact.

snippets.name: Out of office reply
snippets.description: Auto-reply with return date and backup contact.

snippets.name: Thank-you note
snippets.content:
Hi {{name}},

Thank you so much for {{text: reason; label=Thank them for; placeholder=your time yesterday}}. I really appreciate it.

Best,
{{me.name}}
snippets.description: Rich-text thank-you email.

snippets.name: WhatsApp greeting
snippets.content: {{= greeting()}} {{name}}! 👋 Hope you are doing well.

snippets.name: Payment reminder
snippets.description: Polite reminder with amount and deadline; tone changes when overdue.

snippets.name: Payment received
snippets.content:
Hi {{name}}, we have received your payment of {{currency: paid; required}} on {{date: on; default=today}}. Thank you!
{{currency: total; label=Total invoice amount; hidden}}{{if: total > paid}}Remaining balance: {{= total - paid; format=currency}}.{{else}}Your account is fully settled. ✅{{endif}}
snippets.description: Acknowledge a payment with remaining balance.

snippets.name: Invoice summary with tax
snippets.description: Line items, discount and tax with a dynamic table.

snippets.name: Ticket acknowledgement
snippets.content:
Hi {{customer}},

Thank you for contacting {{me.company}} support. Your ticket #{{text: ticket; required}} has been created.
{{select: priority; options=Low,Normal,High,Urgent; default=Normal; hidden}}Priority: {{priority}} — we aim to respond within {{= choose(priority, "Urgent", "2 hours", "High", "8 hours", "Normal", "1 business day", "3 business days")}}.

Best regards,
{{me.name}}
snippets.description: Acknowledge a support ticket with SLA by priority.

snippets.name: Refund approved
snippets.content: Hi {{customer}}, your refund of {{currency: amount; required}} has been approved. It should reach your {{select: method; options=original payment method,bank account,store credit}} within {{number: days; default=5}} business days (by {{= formatdate(addbusinessdays(today(), days), "D MMM")}}).
snippets.description: Confirms a refund and expected timeline.

snippets.name: Ticket closing
snippets.description: Close a ticket and ask for feedback.

snippets.name: Leave request
snippets.description: Leave application with automatic day count.

snippets.name: Team announcement
snippets.content:
📢 {{text: title; required}}

Hello team,

{{textarea: body; required}}

When: {{datetime: when; default=+1d}}
Where: {{text: where; default=Main conference room}}

Thanks,
{{me.name}}
snippets.description: Formatted internal announcement.

snippets.name: Circular / notice
snippets.description: Official circular for students or staff.

snippets.name: Fee due reminder
snippets.content:
Dear Parent/Guardian of {{student}},

This is to remind you that the {{select: term; options=Term 1,Term 2,Annual}} fee of {{currency: fee; required}} is due on {{date: due; default=+10d}}.
{{number: fine_per_day; label=Late fine per day; default=50; hidden}}A late fine of {{= fine_per_day; format=currency}} per day applies after the due date.

Kindly ignore if already paid.
Accounts Office, {{me.company}}
snippets.description: Fee reminder with late fine calculation.

snippets.name: Admission enquiry reply
snippets.content:
Dear {{applicant}},

Thank you for your interest in the {{select: program; options=B.Sc.,B.Com.,B.A.,BBA,BCA,M.Sc.,MBA; required}} program at {{me.company}}.

Applications for the {{text: session; default=2025-26}} session close on {{date: deadline; default=+30d}}. Documents required:
{{repeat: docs; label=Document; min=1}}  {{index}}. {{text: doc; default=Mark sheets}}
{{endrepeat}}
For any questions, call us at {{me.phone}}.

Admissions Office
snippets.description: Respond to admission enquiries with program details.

snippets.name: Admission offer
snippets.content:
Dear {{applicant}},

Congratulations! We are pleased to offer you admission to {{program}} for the {{session}} session.
{{section: scholarship; label=Scholarship awarded?}}You have also been awarded a scholarship of {{number: pct; label=Scholarship %; min=1; max=100}}%, reducing your tuition from {{currency: tuition}} to {{= discount(tuition, pct); format=currency}}.
{{endsection}}
Please confirm your acceptance by {{date: confirm_by; default=+14d}}.

Warm regards,
{{me.name}}, Admissions
snippets.description: Offer letter with scholarship handling.

snippets.name: Absence notification
snippets.content: Dear Parent, this is to inform you that {{student}} of class {{text: class}} was absent on {{date: on; default=today; format=dddd, D MMM}}{{text: periods; label=Periods missed (optional); hidden}}{{if: periods}} for {{periods}}{{endif}}. Kindly share the reason with the class teacher. — {{me.company}}
snippets.description: Notify a parent about absence.

snippets.content:
Hi {{name}},

{{date: sent; label=When did you last write?; default=-7d; hidden}}{{if: datediff(sent, today()) > 14}}It's been a while since my message on {{= formatdate(sent, "D MMMM")}}, so I wanted to check back in{{else}}Just following up on my previous email{{endif}} about {{text: topic; required}}. Please let me know if you need anything else from my side.

Best,
{{me.name}}
